tree: OpenTree induced topology; random polytomy resolution; Grafen power=1 branch lengths
interpretation_boundary: The prespecified nonwhite-to-white asymmetry gate failed.
All 100 primary topology resolutions had q(nonwhite->white)/q(white->nonwhite) < 1.
The opposite direction is descriptive under this opened dataset because no reverse-direction confirmation gate was prespecified.
The recurrent white/nonwhite axis should not be described as a confirmed repeated pigmented-to-white evolutionary transition.
hard_nonclaims: does not estimate absolute evolutionary rates
does not establish within-population mutation direction
does not identify anthocyanin loss as the molecular mechanism
does not establish heat or pollinator causation
does not establish the ancestral flower colour of angiosperms
